executor.description: Trusted .js or .mjs executor; relative paths resolve beside the scenario TOML.

env-file.description: Flutter JSON or .env define file; relative paths resolve beside the scenario TOML. CLI --dart-define-from-file options replace this default.

flavor.description: Flutter build flavor. CLI --flavor replaces this default; requires a Flutter project, not a prebuilt APK.

dimensions.description: Emulator display shortcut (big: 1280x2856 at 480 dpi) or explicit width and height in pixels and density in dpi. CLI --dimensions replaces this default. Omit both to keep the emulator defaults.

domains.description: Exact hostnames or *.hostname filters. Omit to capture all HTTP(S) requests.
